text: REJECT. The new `IsFirstPartySource` calls `SourceClassifier.IsAmbientTypeScriptDeclaration` unqualified, but the original code used the fully qualified `CodeHealth.Core.Classification.SourceClassifier`, and the diff adds no `using CodeHealth.Core.Classification;`, so it most likely fails to compile (CS0103), which breaks the warnings-as-errors build. The complexity reduction and the behaviour (the `--count` decrement still only happens for first-party files) look fine, but I couldn't see the file's existing usings to rule out the compile error.
